summary: This document describes uniform patterns for building HTTP URLs to retrieve registration information from Regional Internet Registries and Domain Name Registries, using RESTful web access. These patterns define the query syntax of the Registration Data Access Protocol (RDAP). It obsoletes RFC 7482.

eli5.summary: If you want to look up who registered a website, you need to know how to ask. This document says exactly how to write the web address for that question.

questions: how to query rdap by url
